headline: OONI's China anomaly index is 57.7% across 244,328 measurements
dek: The index aggregates volunteer-probe observations across network test families inside China.

claims.statement: The current OONI aggregate reports a 57.7% anomaly index across 244,328 China measurements.

method.summary: side-channel: we ingest OONI's already-aggregated open data; we never probe a censored resource ourselves (vantage-insensitive)

limitations: Volunteer-probe coverage is uneven across place, network and test family; anomalies are not all attributable to censorship.
